title: HMW DNA Extraction for Insects
author: Tom Harrop
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pnwdmfe
materials: The goal of this step is to pulverise the insects without allowing them to thaw. Grinding time requires optimisation to balance DNA yield against physical damage to the DNA. Grind insects using a Retsch mixer mill MM 400 / Qiagen TissueLyser or similar with blocks pre-cooled in liquid N 2 for 90 seconds at 20 Hz. After grinding, immediately return the tubes to liquid nitrogen. Ground samples can be stored at -80°C until you're ready to continue.
Equilibrate a QIAGEN Genomic-tip 20/G with 1 mL Buffer QBT. Wait for the Genomic-tip to drain by gravity. You can do this during step 7. Buffer QBT Contributed by users

The goal of this step is to pulverise the insects without allowing them to thaw. Grinding time requires optimisation to balance DNA yield against physical damage to the DNA. Grind insects using a Retsch mixer mill MM 400 / Qiagen TissueLyser or similar with blocks pre-cooled in liquid N 2 for 90 seconds at 20 Hz. After grinding, immediately return the tubes to liquid nitrogen. Ground samples can be stored at -80°C until you're ready to continue.

steps.title: Freeze insects with beads
steps.instruction: Place insects in a 1.7 mL tube with two RNase‑free 3.2 mm stainless steel beads (Catalog #NEXSSB32‑RNA), then snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare lysis buffer
steps.instruction: For each sample, add 1.5 µL RNase A (100 mg/mL, Qiagen Catalog #19101) to 1438.5 µL Buffer G2 (Qiagen Catalog #1014636) to make the lysis buffer.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL Proteinase K (20 mg/mL, Qiagen Catalog #19131) to the sample, invert gently, and incubate at 50 °C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer to powdered sample
steps.instruction: Remove the powdered insect sample from liquid nitrogen or a –80 °C freezer and immediately add 1440 µL of the lysis buffer prepared in step 2.

steps.title: Incubate lysate
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes with inversion.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 20 minutes to pellet debris; using a P1000, slowly transfer 1200 µL of the supernatant to a 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Dilute lysate
steps.instruction: Dilute the collected lysate to approximately 3 mL (exact volume not critical; a more dilute lysate will pass through the column faster).

steps.title: Load lysate onto Genomic‑tip
steps.instruction: Gently invert lysate a few times, pour as much as possible from the 15 mL tube into the QIAGEN Genomic‑tip, pulse‑spin the tube to collect remaining lysate, slowly pipette it into the tip with a P1000, and allow the tip to drain by gravity (30–60 minutes, avoid applying pressure).

steps.title: Wash Genomic‑tip with Buffer QC
steps.instruction: Wash the tip with 1 mL Buffer QC, repeat three additional times for a total of 4 mL Buffer QC.

steps.title: Elute DNA with Buffer QF
steps.instruction: Elute DNA into a new 15 mL tube by adding 2 mL Buffer QF and allowing the tip to drain by gravity.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA in isopropanol
steps.instruction: Split the 2 mL eluate into three 1.7 mL tubes (~667 µL each); to each tube add 467 µL room‑temperature 2‑propanol (Bio‑Basic Catalog #PC8601.SIZE.4L), invert ~10 times, then centrifuge 20 minutes at 15,000 g, 4 °C to pellet DNA.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant (retain if desired for later yield check), pulse‑spin the tubes and remove any residual liquid with a P10 pipette.

steps.title: Ethanol wash (twice)
steps.instruction: Add ~1 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, invert a few times, centrifuge 10 minutes at 15,000 g, 4 °C; discard ethanol, pulse‑spin, then repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Briefly air‑dry the DNA pellet (do not over‑dry); use a P10 to remove remaining ethanol droplets and allow residual moisture to evaporate.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA in EB
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 55 µL Qiagen EB buffer (Tris‑Cl pH 8, Qiagen Catalog #19086) without pipetting up‑and‑down; incubate overnight at room temperature with inversion.

steps.title: Quality control
steps.instruction: Visualise 1 µL of sample on a 0.7 % agarose gel (run in TBE at 80 V for 60 minutes, post‑stain 30 minutes in 0.1 mg/mL EtBr) to estimate fragment size; quantify DNA with Qubit (dilute 1:10 if using HS kit) and assess purity with a Nanodrop (1 µL).
